id: title:DanielVisca:click an activity bar to filter to that bucket

review.posthog_relevance: Adds typed parameters and shared state changes to the Tracing date-range selection and Sparkline comparison overlay, allowing downstream components to distinguish selection sources and use resolved absolute end values.
review.reason: This chunk establishes the shared state and action interfaces for the Tracing date-range selection and Sparkline comparison overlay. It adds typed parameters and shared state changes, allowing downstream components to distinguish selection sources and use resolved absolute end values. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not include the implementation of the date-range resolution, the SparklineCompareOverlay, or the complete TracingSparkline component, so the tier cannot be established. No score.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the date-range resolution, the SparklineCompareOverlay, or the complete TracingSparkline component, so the tier cannot be established. No score.

observations.behavior: Adds utcDateRange to the useValues destructuring, exposing the resolved absolute end of the window.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows downstream components to use the resolved absolute end rather than a relative or null value.

observations.behavior: Passes the resolved absolute end and the active comparison state to the sparkline chart, and the chart now returns the source of the selection.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the chart to distinguish between a drag and a bar click, and to use the absolute end when the selection reaches the last bucket.

observations.behavior: Adds a new source parameter to setDateRange and records the source of the selection.
observations.code_quote: setDateRange: ({ source }) => actions.handleFilterChange('date_range', source ? { source } : undefined),
observations.posthog_connection: Allows downstream consumers to distinguish between a drag and a bar click, and to use the absolute end when the selection reaches the last bucket.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a frontend-only change. No backend, API, or shared type changes are supplied, so the tier cannot be established. No score.

observations.behavior: Adds an optional `source` parameter to setDateRange and its action, and a `sparklineWindowMs` parameter to utcDateRange.
observations.code_quote: setDateRange: (dateRange: DateRange, source?: TracingDateRangeSource) => ({ dateRange, source }),
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the caller to specify where the date range came from, potentially distinguishing between user selection and sparkline-derived ranges.

observations.behavior: Changes utcDateRange to accept sparklineWindowMs and no longer allows date_to to be null; it now derives date_to from sparklineWindowMs.endMs.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the date range calculation to use the sparkline window end instead of a potentially null date_to, preventing the filter from defaulting to 'now' when a sparkline selection is made.

observations.behavior: Updates the shared value type and action signature to reflect the new non-null date_to and the addition of source and sparklineWindowMs parameters.
observations.posthog_connection: Updates the shared state and action interface to match the implementation, removing the possibility of a null date_to and adding the source and sparklineWindowMs parameters.
